xg_for.definition: source-measured historical shot-quality statistic; never engine-derived target scoring rate

xg_against.definition: source-measured historical shot-quality statistic; never engine-derived target scoring rate

feature_semantics.home_attack_sustainability: minus: underlying output less sustainable than goals; zero: evidenced no discrepancy; plus: creation exceeds surface output; null: unsupported
feature_semantics.home_defensive_vulnerability: minus: underlying defense more resilient than concessions; plus: underlying exposure worse; zero: evidenced no discrepancy; null: unsupported
feature_semantics.match_openness: minus: less open interaction; plus: more open interaction; zero: evidenced continuity; null: no matchup support
feature_semantics.home_availability_impact: minus: weaker available resources than observed sample; plus: stronger; zero: supported continuity; null: unverified
feature_semantics.schedule_imbalance: minus: home disadvantaged; plus: away disadvantaged; zero: verified no imbalance; null: incomplete schedule

metric_definitions.arithmetic_mean_of_observed_match_values: sum of unique observed match-field values / actual available matches; expected denominator counts all declared eligible matches; conflict -> null
metric_definitions.paired_historical_score_summary_v1: historical score predicate or sum across paired observed regulation-time goals / usable paired matches; never a target probability
metric_definitions.elapsed_since_latest_declared_fixture_no: (evidence cutoff - latest declared played time) in days; no claim of complete rest
